name: Sally
message: 「Today is such a weird day! Everyone's giving me food as presents!」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't scarf it down so fast? No way! I hate holding back!」

name: Sally
message: 「You want me to savor my birthday cake more?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, come to think of it, someone asked, so I think I just randomly said it was today!」

name: Sally
message: 「Aww. In that case, I should've said it's every day!」
